# Composio

Composio enables AI Agents and LLMs to authenticate and integrate with various tools via function calling.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/composio/.

## Actions

- **Execute Composio Tool**: Execute a tool using the composio api.
- **Execute Composio Tool**: Execute a tool using the composio api.
- **Multi Execute Composio Tools**: Fast and parallel tool executor for tools discovered through COMPOSIO_SEARCH_TOOLS.
- **Multi Execute Composio Tools**: Fast and parallel tool executor for tools discovered through COMPOSIO_SEARCH_TOOLS.
